cold_corners.use: TC5 and TC6 at each of the four (G_iso, G_lead) combinations; the governing cold result is the lowest T_min and the largest heater over the four

hot_corner.use: every hot case (TC1-TC4, TC7, S1), the grid search, the confirmation, the allowable and the T_SC sensitivity

nominal_corner.use: TC1 and TC3 reported only (never used to select or to pass)

power_penalty_vs_P6.note: the lead loss is the RF-chain penalty of R-1 against the P6 ledger (v2 had no lead); dP at the anchor for the same delivered power; the non-operating heater is a survival load outside the firing bus allocation (REFERENCE_PENDING_ICD)

p7_closure_state.rule: the P7 closure-state precedence of thermal_cases_prereg_v1 /closure_state_rule is applied to the selected route: DCR REQUIRED only if a limited node still fails; REFERENCE/ICD DEPENDENT when Q into the spacecraft exceeds the 50 W governing allocation or the T_SC sensitivity changes a verdict; FROZEN FOR EM when every limited node passes and the rest are EM verification requirements; CLOSED is not reachable (NOT_VALIDATED model, PARAMETRIC cases)

selection.rule: R-1 if R-1 is admissible (DCR-DBF1-003 is then WITHDRAWN: no DBF-1 value changes; the match isolation, radiator and lead become registered design-completion values for a P7 load-input / network version); otherwise R-2 if R-2 is admissible (DCR-DBF1-003 proceeds as DBF-1.1 for the coordinator); otherwise BLOCKED with the residual (the N_MATCH shortfall of R-1 and the failed R-2 criterion with its quantity)
